Summary: 55 read-only Azure checks: 37 automated APRL-mapped recommendations and 18 local custom controls using Azure Resource Manager and Resource Graph.

Prerequisites.Text: Azure Reader access to the subscriptions you want to assess. The management-group hierarchy check also requires Reader visibility at the tenant root management group to evaluate the full hierarchy.

Steps.Text: Connect to Azure using Maester's Azure PowerShell service.

Notes: Azure CLI az login alone does not create the Az.Accounts context used by these checks.

Commands.Text: Run only this pack and create the standard Maester report.

AppOnly.Text: Application-only authentication has not been validated for this pack.
